req.title: Basic-auth accepts correct credentials
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> with HTTP 200 and an authenticated=true JSON body when the supplied Basic credentials match.

doc.reasoning: The basic_auth handler in httpbin/core.py calls check_basic_auth(user, passwd) which inspects request.authorization and compares username/password. We need: (1) positive EP test with correct credentials returning 200 + {authenticated:true, user:<user>}; (2) negative tests for wrong password, wrong user, and missing auth header returning 401; (3) boundary tests for single-character credentials and special characters. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact JSON body fields to kill comparison-flip, boolean-negation, and constant-mutation mutants. We also verify the 401 WWW-Authenticate header to catch mutations in the status_code helper.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic auth header matching path params
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert len(data) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with Basic auth header using wrong password
expected: WWW-Authenticate header present with Basic realm
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:wrongpass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 401
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 403
www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
assert 'Basic' in www_auth

tests.name: test_basic_auth_user_field_matches_path_param_not_header_user
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with correct credentials for alice
Verify returned user field equals path param user, not a hardcoded value
expected: JSON body user field equals 'alice' exactly
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['user'] == 'alice'
assert data['user'] != 'user'

assert data['authenticated'] is True
assert data['authenticated'] != False

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_user_wrong_pass_and_correct_pass_wrong_user_both_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/bob/pass1 with user=bob password=WRONG -> expect 401
Send GET /basic-auth/bob/pass1 with user=WRONG password=pass1 -> expect 401
Send GET /basic-auth/bob/pass1 with user=bob password=pass1 -> expect 200
expected: Third request returns 200 with authenticated=true and user=bob
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

creds_wrong_pass = base64.b64encode(b'bob:WRONG').decode('ascii')
r1 = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds_wrong_pass}'})
assert r1.status_code == 401

creds_wrong_user = base64.b64encode(b'WRONG:pass1').decode('ascii')
r2 = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds_wrong_user}'})
assert r2.status_code == 401

creds_correct = base64.b64encode(b'bob:pass1').decode('ascii')
r3 = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds_correct}'})
assert r3.status_code == 200
data = r3.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'bob'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_chars_in_credentials
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user123/p%40ss with URL-encoded special char password matching Basic auth
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
password = 'p@ss'
creds = base64.b64encode(f'user123:{password}'.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/user123/p%40ss', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'user123'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_authenticated_field_is_exactly_true_not_truthy
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert authenticated field is boolean True, not just truthy
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] is True
assert type(data['authenticated']) == bool
assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
